rules.accepted_credit_types: AMA Category 1, AOA Category 1, AAFP Prescribed, ACOG Cognates Category 1, or ACEP Category 1
rules.carryover: CME used to satisfy a Board order or deficiency does not count toward the next biennium.
rules.audit_note: No documents with renewal; answer CME compliance questions. Keep records 5 years; the Board audits a fixed percentage of renewals. CE Broker tracking optional.

topics.who: Physicians with an active DEA certificate who prescribe controlled substances; AMA/AOA PRA Category 1, once in a career
All physicians: professional boundaries and physician sexual misconduct, once in a career
Pain clinic physicians without pain management or palliative medicine certification; counts toward the 40 hours

rules.notes: One board for MDs and DOs. License renews every two years by the last day of the birth month.
